Technical Committee for
BIM Standardisation.

BIM Excellence Award 2026

Presentation

The Technical Committee (CT) 197 – BIM is the entity designated by the Instituto Português da Qualidade (IPQ) to lead standardisation actions in the field of Building Information Modelling (BIM). Its activity covers classification systems, information modelling and processes throughout the life cycle of built assets.

CT 197 – BIM's mission is to promote the digitalisation of the construction sector, ensuring greater efficiency, collaboration and sustainability throughout the life cycle of assets. By establishing standards and guidelines aligned with national and international benchmarks, the committee contributes to the modernisation and competitiveness of the AECO sector (Architecture, Engineering, Construction and Operation).

CT 197 – BIM was created in March 2015, on the initiative of the IPQ, the National Standardisation Body (ONN), and coordinated by the Instituto Superior Técnico (IST), the Sectoral Standardisation Body (ONS). At that time, the chair was held by Professor António Aguiar Costa of IST and the secretariat by PhD candidate Rúben Santos of IST.

In March 2020, the secretary of CT 197 – BIM became Architect Pedro Lucas Martins. In December 2021, CT 197 – BIM began to be coordinated by BUILT CoLAB (ONS). In March 2025, Researcher Paula Couto of the Laboratório Nacional de Engenharia Civil (LNEC) was elected chair of CT 197 – BIM, and the following month Researcher Maria João Falcão Silva of LNEC was appointed secretary.

Objectives of CT 197 - BIM:

  • Participate in the drafting of European and international standards, ensuring Portugal's reality is represented;
  • Promote the translation of European and international standardisation documents;
  • Develop national standardisation documents, such as technical specifications;
  • Disseminate knowledge in the field of standardisation;
  • Create good practice guides to help the sector understand and implement BIM.

Standardisation in Portugal

In Portugal, the BIM standardisation process involves collaboration between several entities, namely:

  • IPQ (National Standardisation Body) – responsible for coordinating the standardisation subsystem, promoting the sustainable development of national standardisation activity and ensuring convergence between national and international efforts.
  • BUILT CoLAB (Sectoral Standardisation Body) – coordinates CT 197, and is responsible for producing standardisation documents, drawing up the Standardisation Programme's plan and activity report, and disseminating the sector's standardisation activities.
  • CT 197 – BIM (Technical Committee) – dedicated to standardisation in the context of BIM.

Activity

The production of standardisation documents at CT 197 – BIM is an ongoing process, driven by the voluntary contribution of its members. This work has been divided between transposing European and international standards to the Portuguese reality and creating exclusively national documents, such as technical specifications.

In addition, documents are developed with the support of, or in collaboration with, CT 197 – BIM, which may be made available free of charge for public consultation, contributing to the dissemination of knowledge and the adoption of good practices in the sector.

CT 197 – BIM also actively monitors the development of BIM standards at European and international level, ensuring that Portugal is aligned with global best practice and has influence over content under development.

The main Technical Committees monitored are:

  • CEN/TC 442 – the European committee responsible for BIM standardisation in Europe
  • ISO/TC 59/SC 13 – the ISO committee dedicated to digitalisation in construction, including BIM

Collaborating with CT197 - BIM

CT 197 – BIM is open to collaboration from entities and professionals interested in the development of BIM in Portugal. If you are interested in becoming a member of the committee, taking part in standardisation activities and contributing technical knowledge to the sector's development, please send an e-mail to pcouto@lnec.pt identifying the following details:

  • E-mail subject: Request to Join CT 197 – BIM;
  • Reason for the request;
  • Name of the requesting entity;
  • Name and position of the full member;
  • Name and position of the alternate member (optional);
  • E-mail and phone number of the member(s);
  • Correspondence address.

BIM Excellence Award

Find out more here about this CT 197 – BIM initiative, with the support of BUILT CoLAB and PTPC/AEC Cluster, which aims to value and promote digitalisation and the implementation of BIM at national level, through the dissemination and promotion of good practices, especially those resulting from existing standards.
